core_obligations: Represent the two complexes by explicit complexes and filter each of them by truncations (proof lines 15812-15815).

Apply the filtered proposition, noting that the associated graded piece of the truncation filtration is the shifted cohomology, to obtain a first-quadrant spectral sequence with the displayed first page (proof lines 15815-15822).
Reindex the bidegrees by the displayed substitution so that the differentials have bidegree (r, -r+1) (proof lines 15824-15830).
Record that the reindexed spectral sequence has the second page claimed in the statement (proof lines 15830-15832).
proof_roadmap: Filter both complexes by truncations (proof lines 15812-15815).
Read off the second page (proof lines 15830-15832).
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the Kunneth spectral sequence computing the derived tensor product of two bounded complexes, with second page given by Tor of the cohomology groups, and the proof is a 21-line construction by reindexing. It represents the two complexes by explicit complexes, filters them by truncations so that the associated graded pieces are the cohomology groups shifted, applies the filtered-proposition of the same section to obtain a first-quadrant spectral sequence with an explicit first page, and then reindexes the bidegrees so that the differentials have the announced bidegree and the second page becomes the Tor expression of the statement. The truncation step and the reindexing are the substance, and both are displayed.
